author: mcrochiere

title: Great tour to the Dali museum and Girona
text:
We have taken many Viator tours but this one was one of the best! Our guide Noelia was terrific.  She was extremely knowledgeable about all things Dali and her passion was clearly evident. Thanks to her narration our trip to the Dali museum was greatly enhanced and we learned so much more than had we toured on our own.
As a native from the area around Girona it was a pleasure touring the city sites with her. Highly recommend this tour and Noelia.

title: A perfect day in Figueres and Girona
text: The amazing guide Noellia has offered us the perfect day in Figueres and in Girona. So knowledgeable, so passionate about  Dali and his works and life, so friendly and always having the best tips at hand! I can only recommend the tour, it was much more than expected - the group was small and we have had everything taken care of smoothly and professionally. Noellia, you made our day! Muchas gracias!

title: Discovering Dalí Museum and Girona Through the Eyes of a Great Guide
text:
A day before the tour, our guide, Gaspar, thoughtfully informed us of the hotel pick-up time, and he was punctual on the day itself. He was humorous, knowledgeable and engaging, guiding us throughout the tour and sharing fascinating insights that deepened our understanding of Salvador Dalí, as well as the history and culture of Girona.

Thank you, Gaspar, for such a wonderful and enriching experience. We are bringing home not just beautiful memories, but also valuable knowledge and a deeper appreciation of the places we visited. It was truly an experience to remember!
